entities.summary: Greek mathematician (c. 300 BCE) whose Elements remained the standard textbook for geometry for over 2,000 years. Working in Alexandria, Euclid systematized existing mathematical knowledge into a deductive framework of definitions, axioms, and proofs that became the model for logical reasoning in Western science.
